title: Post-bounce chop – leaders extended, stops getting hit
body:
Market phase = Trend -> Chop transition

Strategy mismatch:
Breakout style used in non-trending conditions

Better approach:

Focus on:
Pullbacks to 10/20 EMA
Tight consolidations

Avoid:
Late-stage breakouts
thesis:
Market is in post-rally digestion phase:

Early trend phase is over -> now rotation + shakeouts
Extended names -> prone to pullbacks
Tight stops getting hit = noise environment

Key shift:
Move from aggressive breakout trading -> defensive, selective approach
lesson_learned: In extended + choppy markets, reduce size, avoid chasing, and let setups come to you.
what_went_well:
Followed system and respected stops
Correctly identified weak market internals
Maintained discipline despite losses
what_went_wrong:
Entered extended stocks
Used tight stops in noisy market
Slight overexposure
Missed partial trailing opportunity (MTARTECH)

title: Using higher timeframe bias to improve swing trade accuracy
one_line_summary: Higher timeframe defines edge, lower timeframe refines execution.
body:
Weekly = direction
Daily = setup
Lower TF = optional refinement.

Best setups:
HTF uptrend + daily pullback
HTF base + daily breakout

Avoid:
Counter-trend trades
Extended entries far from HTF support
observations:
Market recently bounced -> entering digestion
Leaders extended and choppy
Lower timeframe signals unreliable
Higher timeframe trends still intact in select names
thesis:
Higher timeframe (weekly/daily) provides:

Clear trend direction
Reliable structure
Better probability setups

Lower timeframe creates noise -> leading to:

False entries
Frequent stop-outs

Key idea:
Align trades with higher timeframe trend, use daily for execution
lesson_learned: Higher timeframe defines edge, lower timeframe refines execution.
what_went_well:
Better trade selection using HTF bias
Avoided low-quality setups
Reduced unnecessary trades
what_went_wrong:
Occasional early entries on daily
Minor impatience waiting for confirmation
action_plan:
Always start analysis from weekly chart
Trade only in direction of HTF trend
Enter on daily setups (pullback / breakout)
Avoid lower timeframe noise-based decisions
Use 20 EMA for trailing
anchor_thought: Trade what the higher timeframe confirms, not what the lower timeframe tempts.
